title: Barnyard First Birthday
description: A first birthday staged outdoors around a pink playhouse — hay bales, a whitewashed barrel, blush and white florals, and an oversized number one. Indoors it carries on as a soft-farm setup: an “adopt a pony” backdrop under a cream and cow-print garland, with plush ponies lined up on shelves for guests to take home and a wagon wheel and hay bale finishing the corner.
